name: ch4_fig24_moma_room_patterns
prompt: Title (top): "MOMA와 ROOM의 변화 패턴" + smaller warm-grey "Distributed vs Sparse Changes". Draw two equal panels with one shared baseline. Left panel title "MOMA" and label "여러 반응의 작은 변화": draw exactly 10 blue vertical reaction bars, each showing a small deviation from its pale grey reference top, with no arrows and no reference text. Right panel title "ROOM" and label "소수 반응의 큰 변화": draw exactly 10 bars, eight unchanged grey and exactly two orange bars with large deviations. Add one unlabeled red bracket around only the two orange bars. Do not add panel letters, "WT", a bracket label, numbers, or any other text. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every bar, tag, and bracket has one perfectly uniform solid fill or stroke. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no other text, numbers, captions, or labels.
